aurora.title:
Aurora Top 10
Teaser & Trophy
aurora.description: 3d motion and physical trophy for the Aurora Tech Award by inDrive — the only startup award for female tech founders in emerging markets. Animated the Top 10 announcement teaser and designed the winners’ statuette, awarded to the top three at the 2026 ceremony in Santiago, Chile.

dodo-deck.title:
Dodo Pizza Dubai
Partnership Deck
dodo-deck.description: Strategic presentation for Dodo Pizza Dubai partnerships. Designed to give partners a comprehensive brand overview. I focused on visual clarity and structuring content for maximum impact, delivering a fully editable template, allowing the team to easily update data and adapt the deck for future partners.

ipak.title:
Ipak Yuli
3d System
ipak.description: 3d visual system for a bank. Developed scalable asset library and managed daily production, setting a new visual trend in local banking.

goethe.title: Ethereal 3d bird reimagining a Goethe-Institut poetry event symbol, across print posters, social, and an animated stage backdrop.

dodo-finance.title: Custom enamel pins turning Dodo Pizza's identity into playful, wearable merch.

yandex-go.title: A polished 3d games icon for the Yandex Go home screen, and the launch visuals for its power-bank rental.

edadeal.title:
Edadeal
Brand Character
edadeal.description: Evolved the logo into a rigged 3d ecosystem for Yandex’s cashback service. I provide ongoing support for themed expansion packs.

wolfram.title:
designworkout
wolfram74 zine
wolfram.description: Photography, original writing, and foam lettering for a collaborative zine. Exploring the theme of Conjuring, I drew a parallel between hiking endurance and the magical, transformative nature of design.

kvass.title:
Identity for a
crafted kvas brand
kvass.description: A bold fusion of sharp lettering and fluid, Art Nouveau‑inspired rye patterns. The design creates a dynamic rhythm on the aluminum can, modernizing traditional motifs with an elegant edge.
